intro.text: An account whose writer reflects on having been watched throughout their life.
Masha-daughter-Shaliv's account of Kaladin and Szeth's mission in Shinovar.

description.text: Written six years after the Night of Sorrows, it forms part of a larger historical work with contributions from several authors.
Masha interviewed Szeth and Nightblood and received information about Kaladin from Jasnah. Her sources did not tell her about Kaladin's place in the renewed Oathpact.
